title: Lunchtime at the Hawker Centre
scene: A busy neighbourhood hawker centre at lunchtime, where people of all races eat together and a schoolgirl helps an elderly woman carry her tray.
questions: Describe what the people in this picture are doing.
Why do you think the girl is helping the elderly woman?
Tell me about a time you ate at a hawker centre with your family.
Some people do not return their trays. What do you think about that?
Why are hawker centres important to people in Singapore?
